about: Model -> Loom card for 1bit serve's GPU route (docs/loom-route.md). A .gguf served on the GPU (--device auto or hrx) whose entry matches runs on loom-serve (AMD's Loom programs on the HRX runtime); every other model runs on the llama.cpp fork's llama-server as before. An entry is added only after the model passed the Loom-vs-fallback gate (interleaved A/B speed and accuracy on strixhalo, docs/loom-route.md "Gate"), with the gate's result linked in `gate`.

routes.gate: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/engine/issues/3158#issuecomment-7094317837 (accuracy, split layout) + https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/engine/issues/3158#issuecomment-7092325966 (precondition + speed through 1bit serve); card huggingface.co/1bit-MONSTER/Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct-GGUF-loom; device = the default completion spin per the spin A/B (https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/engine/pull/3369)
